items.title: Sheryl Bailey interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 24, 2023
items.q: Sheryl was interviewed via Zoom on July 24, 2023 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

ctx.x: Sheryl was interviewed via Zoom on July 24, 2023 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive and I’m very pleased to have Sheryl Bailey with me today, a jazz guitarist and educator. And in an article in Vintage Guitar magazine you were described as “Guitar goddess of modern jazz.”
